lines.text: [VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: Oh!\nHey, [VAR TRNAME(0000)]!
Seems like we can’t pass through the gate there.
But the [VAR COLOR(0006)]Underground Path[VAR COLOR(0000)] should take us to\n[VAR COLOR(0006)]Vermilion City[VAR COLOR(0000)].\c\nIt’s a bit dark and spooky, though...
Huh?
Hold still for one sec, [VAR TRNAME(0000)]...
I was wondering what the sparkly thing was.\nThis was stuck in your hair!
You got a Revive from [VAR TRNAME(0001)]!

Revives can heal Pokémon that have been
knocked out in battle.\c
I have a few extra, so...
Here, take some of mine, too!
You got 2 Revives from [VAR TRNAME(0001)]!
Maybe those will help you when you take on\nthe next Gym!
...Huh? Are those S.S. Tickets you have?
Here, take one!
I’ve got one extra, so...

No way! They’re for the S.S. Anne, right?\c
I hear it’s a luxury cruise liner that’s traveled
all over the world!\c
Man, I’d love a chance to see what it’s like on
the inside, even just once...
You gave [VAR TRNAME(0001)] one of your\nS.S. Tickets.
Hey, are you sure I can have this?\nYou know I’m definitely going, right?\c\nWhere’d you get this, anyway?
...Eek! You got it from that talking Pokémon?!
What? Oh, it was a person after all?\nWell, I guess that’s good to hear...
Hey, just, uh, forget about that whole thing, OK?
I think I’ll press on ahead! See you there!
